plugin: NetworkService Tripp Lite UPS PDU Environmental SNMP
plugin_desc: Tripp Lite PRODUCTS UPS SNMP collection for appliances under Tripp Lite PEN 850. The shared SNMP floor supplies MIB-II uptime and IF-MIB 64-bit HC interface traffic. This child template adds PRODUCTS battery charge percent and output-line load percent. Shared CPU, memory, fan and power-health scalars are not claimed.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: network_service_tripplite_battery_capacity
metrics.description: PRODUCTS estimated battery charge remaining as a percent of full charge.

metrics.name: network_service_tripplite_output_load
metrics.description: PRODUCTS output-line load as a percent of UPS capacity.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: Average inbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: Average outbound interface bytes per second over five minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: Device uptime since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime.
